description: This file defines the LeadsParseRule class which extends the BaseRule class. It applies specific pre-processing to panel data in the context of a 'DetailView' in a SugarCRM/SuiteCRM module related to 'Leads', replacing certain column identifiers with 'full_name'.

classes.name: LeadsParseRule
classes.description: A rule class for custom parsing of lead panels in the CRM framework, specifically handling 'DetailView' panel data by replacing certain column identifiers.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method for LeadsParseRule. Currently does not perform any initialization.

methods.name: preParse
methods.description: Processes panels before rendering; replaces columns matching 'lead_view_c' with 'full_name' in 'DetailView' context.
